items.question: What was the total estimated expenditure in AED billion of the UAE Federal General Budget 2023-2026?
items.fact: Federal General Budget 2023-2026 total estimated expenditure AED 252.3 billion

items.question: What percentage of the UAE Federal General Budget 2023-2026 was allocated to the government affairs sector, which includes digital government development?
items.fact: Government affairs sector got 38 per cent of 2023-2026 budget
